metaDescription: London Fence Installer won our 2026 Fence Construction award for London, Ontario. See services, warranty details, a client review and service area.
summary: London Fence Installer builds wood, vinyl, chainlink and metal fences for homeowners and businesses across London and Southwestern Ontario. The company is built around fast, organized service, quoting within 48 hours and backing installs with a 5-year limited warranty.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: London Fence Installer works across wood, vinyl, chainlink and metal or aluminum fencing, plus fence repair and fence staining. Offering both new fence installation and staining for existing wood fences means a homeowner can maintain a fence years after the original install with the same contractor.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company says it delivers quotes within 48 hours and backs installs with a 5-year limited warranty. Combined with 20 years of the team's combined experience, this points to a business built around responsive project management, including reliable cleanup, which matters on fence jobs that often border neighbours' properties.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One review, from a London homeowner, describes the process from quote to cleanup as quick and organized for a backyard fence project, with a full five-star rating. It is a single review, so homeowners should treat it as one useful data point alongside their own vetting rather than a full track record.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The business serves London, St. Thomas, Woodstock and surrounding Southwestern Ontario, for both residential and commercial clients. Commercial fencing, such as chainlink for a business property, is handled alongside residential wood and vinyl work.

strengths: Installs four common fence types, wood, vinyl, chainlink and metal or aluminum, under one contractor.
Offers fence staining as an ongoing service, not just fencing installation, for wood fence upkeep.
States a 48-hour quote turnaround, useful for homeowners on a timeline.
Backs installs with a 5-year limited warranty.
Serves both residential and commercial clients across the London area.
considerations: Public review count is limited to one, so ask for recent references directly if you want a broader picture before hiring.
Fence jobs that cross property lines require neighbour agreement on placement; confirm the company handles that coordination.
Best suited to standard residential and commercial fence types; ask directly if your project needs a specialty material.
Seasonal demand for fencing peaks in spring and summer, so book ahead for those windows.
Not a fit if you need ornamental ironwork or specialty gates beyond standard fencing; confirm capability before ordering.
bestFor: Homeowners installing a new wood, vinyl, chainlink or aluminum fence
Anyone needing an existing wood fence stained or refreshed
Commercial properties needing chainlink or security fencing
Homeowners who want a fast quote turnaround before deciding
questionsToAsk: What does the 5-year limited warranty cover, and what would void it?
Do you handle survey or property-line confirmation before installing along a boundary?
What is your current lead time from signed quote to installation?
Can you stain or refinish an existing wood fence to match a new section?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: London Fence Installer was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top fence contractor serving London, Ontario, based on public services, reviews and service area, with no fee involved for consideration or winning.

faq.q: What fence materials do they install?
faq.a: Wood, vinyl, chainlink, and metal or aluminum fencing, for both residential and commercial properties.

faq.q: How fast do they provide a quote?
faq.a: The company states quotes are delivered within 48 hours of a request.

faq.q: Do they also stain fences, not just build them?
faq.a: Yes, fence staining is listed as a service alongside new installation and repair.
